title: Neow Companions
description:
Choose a companion after Neow's starting relic.

Neow Companions adds a large pool of companion relics based on Slay the Spire 2 creatures, elites, and bosses. Each companion has a combat pet, relic icon, custom card, card art, and themed animation triggers.

New elite companions:
Bygone Effigy, Byrdonis, Phrog Parasite, Skulking Colony, Phantasmal Gardener, Terror Eel, Decimillipede, Entomancer, Infested Prism, Knight Gang, Mecha Knight, and Soul Nexus.

Recent highlights:
- Every base-game Ancient now draws companion choices from its own balanced pool. The Show All Companion Options setting takes priority when enabled.
- Added all 12 elite encounters as companions with unique cards and authentic in-game creature figures.
- Normal player Attack cards trigger the active companion's verified in-game attack animation.
- Replaced paged companion choices with a scrollable list.
- Companions remember their dragged position and size between combats. Hold right-click to drag and use the mouse wheel to resize.
- Only one companion can be right-click dragged at a time.
- Card, relic, icon, and companion artwork uses authentic in-game assets. No AI-generated art.

Requires BaseLib.
